# One file that moves the book's AMZN price off 2026-01-06 through its guid,
# and gives a new AMZN price for 2026-01-06.
#
# The new price is written first. Where the blocks sit in the file makes no
# difference: once the move is applied the day is free.
#
# What this fixture produces: the price with guid
# 4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8 at 2026-01-08 21:00 UTC, and a new AMZN
# price of 219.00 USD at 2026-01-06 21:00 UTC.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_price_is_changed_through_its_guid.py.
price
	commodity.namespace: "NASDAQ"
	commodity.mnemonic: "AMZN"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	time: "2026-01-06 21:00:00 +0000"
	value: "21900/100"
	source: "Finance::Quote"
	type: "last"

price
	guid: "4a1a4c0c7328491fbde9f8099ba280c8"
	time: "2026-01-08 21:00:00 +0000"
